posts.title: Retirement
posts.description: I’m about to embark on a new adventure, and I’m not yet sure how I feel about it. I’m hoping writing it out will help clear things up in my head. I’m leaving the BBC shortly before Christmas, with no particular onward destination. I had planned to retire – or at least go part time – when I turn 65 in May 2028.
